connect.title: Connect Slack
connect.intro: Alerts are posted to one Slack channel through an incoming webhook: a private link that lets this app post there.
connect.stepsTitle: How to get a webhook URL
connect.step1: Go to api.slack.com/apps and create an app ("From scratch") in your workspace.
connect.step2: Open "Incoming Webhooks" and turn it on.
connect.step3: Click "Add New Webhook", choose the Slack channel and copy the webhook URL.
connect.name: Name
connect.nameHint: Shown in this app, e.g. #news in Acme.
connect.webhookUrlEditHint: Leave empty to keep the current webhook URL.
connect.secret: Keep the webhook URL private: anyone who has it can post to your Slack channel. We never show it again. When you save a new URL, we send a test message to check it.
